brake-pads-ceramic-front.part_type: Front brake pads, ceramic, axle set
brake-pads-ceramic-front.warnings: Replace pads in axle sets, never one side only. Measure the rotors at the same time: new pads on a rotor below its discard thickness will not stop the car properly. Bed the pads in with six to eight moderate stops from highway-ramp speed before any hard braking.
brake-pads-ceramic-front.outside_listed_years: Not listed for that year. Confirm fitment before buying, and take the torque figures from the service manual for that vehicle.

bands.spec: Caliper bracket bolts 100 ft-lbs. Caliper guide pin bolts 25 ft-lbs. Wheel lug nuts 80 ft-lbs in a star pattern. Replace the pads once the friction material reaches 3 mm.

brake-rotors-front-pair.warnings: Measure both rotors before reusing them. A rotor below its discard thickness is scrap, not a candidate for resurfacing. Always replace rotors in pairs.
brake-rotors-front-pair.outside_listed_years: Not listed for that year. Confirm fitment before buying, and take the thickness figures from the service manual for that vehicle.

bands.spec: New thickness 23 mm. Discard thickness 21.5 mm. Maximum runout 0.04 mm. Wheel lug nuts 80 ft-lbs in a star pattern.

oil-filter-cartridge.warnings: Oil the new gasket before fitting and make sure the old gasket came off with the old filter. Two gaskets will leak.
oil-filter-cartridge.outside_listed_years: Not listed for that year. Confirm fitment before buying, and take the torque figure from the service manual for that vehicle.

bands.spec: Tighten the filter to 18 ft-lbs once the gasket meets the seat. Oil and filter interval 7,500 miles or 12 months, whichever comes first.

full-synthetic-0w20-5qt.part_type: Full synthetic engine oil, SAE 0W-20, API SP
full-synthetic-0w20-5qt.warnings: Use the viscosity printed on the oil filler cap. A thicker oil than the cap calls for can starve the variable valve timing on a cold start.
full-synthetic-0w20-5qt.outside_listed_years: No capacity on file for that year. Take the capacity from the service manual for that vehicle.

bands.spec: Engine oil capacity with a new filter 3.7 quarts. Drain bolt 29 ft-lbs with a new crush washer.

cabin-air-filter.warnings: Fit it with the airflow arrow pointing down, towards the floor of the car. Upside down it restricts the blower.
cabin-air-filter.outside_listed_years: Not listed for that year. Confirm fitment before buying.

bands.spec: Replacement interval 15,000 miles or 12 months. No torque figures: the housing behind the glovebox is clipped, not bolted.
